summary.storyTitle: Story 3: Turn Composition and Chunk Formation
summary.implementedScope: Fixed SV-3.8-001 with production behavior, not test-only marking. Tool-run receipts are now a mechanical artifact: composeRenderingInput (pure) restates each tool part as a ToolRunReceipt { messageId, activity, account, outcome } in message order, and the turn_derivation handler stamps them on turn_rendering.metadata (mechanically derived, never provider-authored — consistent with the existing metadata contract). The two chunk-summary provider inputs now differ by contract: summarizeChunkDetailed receives memberReceipts (full receipts per member, turn order, read from the renderings' stamped metadata via the member-projection query); summarizeChunkBrief receives memberOutcomes only — the receipt account text is stripped in the handler before the provider call, so brief structurally cannot preserve more than outcomes. The deterministic provider and the test double render these fields into the marked output through shared suffix helpers ([receipts account=>outcome; …] on detailed, [outcomes …] on brief), so the landed artifacts carry the evidence and in-process/spawned outputs stay byte-identical. The new seam fields are optional in the type (frozen fixtures.test.ts calls with memberProjections only still typecheck, and empty-receipt inputs produce byte-identical output to before, keeping FC-0.1/0.2 and TC-3.9 determinism green). Independent retry/requeue behavior (TC-3.8 leg 2) untouched and green.

specDeviations.description: Tech design §Interfaces sketches both chunk-summary provider inputs as { memberProjections: string[] }; satisfying AC-3.8's preserve-receipts/outcomes-only contract mechanically required differentiating them — summarizeChunkDetailed gains optional memberReceipts: ToolRunReceipt[][], summarizeChunkBrief gains optional memberOutcomes: ToolOutcome[][], with receipts mechanically stamped on turn_rendering.metadata at derivation. Additive and optional, so existing seam callers are unaffected.
